func Send(to, subject, body string) error {
	client := sendgrid.NewSendClient(os.Getenv("SENDGRID_API_KEY"))
	msg := mail.NewSingleEmail(from, subject, mail.NewEmail("", to), body, body)
	_, err := client.Send(msg)
	return err
}
